# SteamWatch

> SteamWatch (steamwatch.io) tracks the biggest odds moves in football (soccer) betting markets and shows what happened next. It records Pinnacle odds for 1X2, Asian Handicap and Totals markets roughly every 15 minutes across Europe's major leagues, detects significant pre-kickoff price moves ("steam"), sends free real-time Telegram alerts, and keeps a public historical record of how those moves performed.

SteamWatch reports what moved and what happened next. It does not claim to know why a price moved.

## What the data is

- Odds source: Pinnacle, via The Odds API, captured roughly every 15 minutes and stored as time-series snapshots. The closing line is the last snapshot before kickoff.
- Leagues tracked: Premier League, EFL Championship, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Champions League, Europa League, Conference League, UEFA Nations League.
- A "steam move" here means an implied-probability shift of 3+ percentage points on an outcome before kickoff. Alerts fire at 4+ points within 16 hours of kickoff.
- A "drifter" is the opposite of steam: an outcome whose price lengthened (implied probability fell) before kickoff.
- Historical results and closing prices before February 2026 come from football-data.co.uk; from February 2026 they are SteamWatch's own capture.
- Every match has its own page at /match/{id} with the open-to-kickoff price history for all three markets, server-rendered from the database.

## Data pages

- [Live odds and biggest movers](https://www.steamwatch.io/): every tracked match with current prices, the biggest 48-hour moves, and late steam within 16 hours of kickoff.
- [Steam Results](https://www.steamwatch.io/steam-results): every detected steam move tracked through to a result, with win rates, profit and loss and per-team rankings for the current season.
- [Drifters](https://www.steamwatch.io/drifters): the moves going the other way, with the same accounting.
- [Closing Lines](https://www.steamwatch.io/closing-lines): the Pinnacle closing 1X2, Asian handicap and totals price for every finished match, by league and matchweek, with the opening price beside it.
- [Champions League Closing Lines](https://www.steamwatch.io/cl-closing-lines): the same archive for the Champions League.
- [Team P/L](https://www.steamwatch.io/team-pnl): what backing or fading every club in every match at closing prices would have returned, by season and venue, since 2021/22.
- [Longshot Bias](https://www.steamwatch.io/longshot-bias): what backing every favourite, underdog or draw at closing prices returned, by odds band, league, season and venue, plus every club in the top five leagues on its own. 8,867 matches since 2021/22, updated weekly.
- [In-Play Jumps](https://www.steamwatch.io/in-play-jumps): the gap between the Pinnacle close and the Polymarket price in the first five minutes of in-play trading, per match.

## Tools

- [Match Predictor](https://www.steamwatch.io/tools/match-predictor): Dixon-Coles match probabilities and fair odds from each team's xG form, with league constants recomputed every Monday.
- [Rolling xG](https://www.steamwatch.io/tools/rolling-xg): rolling 5 and 10 match non-penalty expected goals for and against, per club, top five leagues, from Understat, refreshed every Monday.
- [Form Lab](https://www.steamwatch.io/tools/form-lab): form tables by opponent strength, handicap cover rates, home and away splits and rolling xG.
- [Club Ratings](https://www.steamwatch.io/tools/club-ratings): weekly strength ratings on one European scale for every club in the top five leagues and the UEFA competitions, published Mondays.
- [Manager Ratings](https://www.steamwatch.io/tools/manager-ratings): managers ranked by the Elo rating points their clubs gained or lost while they were in charge, top five leagues since July 2016.
- [Bet Calculator](https://www.steamwatch.io/tools/bet-calculator): returns on singles, doubles, trebles and accumulators in fractional, decimal or American odds.
- [Hedge Calculator](https://www.steamwatch.io/tools/hedge-calculator): the stake needed on the opposite side to lock in a profit or cap a loss on an open bet.

## Blog

- [What are steam moves?](https://www.steamwatch.io/blog/what-are-steam-moves-in-football-betting): what a steam move is, how to spot one and how to use it.
- [What is closing line value (CLV)?](https://www.steamwatch.io/blog/what-is-closing-line-value-in-football-betting): how to calculate CLV and why beating the close predicts long-term profit.
- [What is a drifter?](https://www.steamwatch.io/blog/what-is-a-drifter-in-football-betting): why odds lengthen before kickoff and how drift relates to steam.
- [How to read closing lines](https://www.steamwatch.io/blog/how-to-read-closing-lines-in-football-betting): implied probability, open-to-close gaps and which markets to trust.
- [Favourite-longshot bias in football: the data](https://www.steamwatch.io/blog/favourite-longshot-bias-in-football-betting): blind favourite, underdog and draw returns across 8,867 Pinnacle closes since 2021/22.
- [Blog index](https://www.steamwatch.io/blog): all posts, newest first.
- [About](https://www.steamwatch.io/about): who runs SteamWatch (Neil Mac, betting analyst, 7,800+ tracked bets).

## Key findings (Longshot Bias: 8,867 top-five-league matches at Pinnacle closing 1X2 prices, 2021/22 to August 2026, flat stakes, updated weekly)

- Backing every favourite returned +0.2%. Backing every underdog returned -10.5%. Backing every draw returned -2.0%.
- The biggest underdogs (closing 5.30 or longer) returned -14.0%; slight favourites (2.19 to 3.09) returned +3.7%.
- Favourites playing away returned +3.2% (3,066 matches); favourites at home returned -1.4% (5,801 matches).
- Serie A underdogs were the worst blind bet at -15.6%; the Bundesliga (+1.1%) and Serie A (+0.4%) were the only leagues where the draw came out ahead.
- Per-team view (all five leagues): e.g. Aston Villa all time +25.9% backing overall.
- Prices: Pinnacle closes (football-data.co.uk to Jan 2026, SteamWatch capture from Feb 2026); Betfair Exchange closes stand in for ~200 matches between the two.

## Key findings (Steam Results track record, 27 January 2026 to 1 September 2026)

- 531 steam moves (3+ percentage-point implied-probability shortening before kickoff at Pinnacle) tracked through to a result: 216 won (40.7%), 128 drew, 187 lost.
- Backing every steam move blind at the detected price returned -3.5%. Backing every drifter blind (797 moves, 35.6% won) also returned -3.5%.
- A steam move shows the market changed its mind; it does not by itself show the market was wrong.

## Access

- Free: real-time steam alerts via Telegram (https://t.me/steamwatchalerts), live odds, biggest movers, match pages, the closing line archive, Team P/L, In-Play Jumps, Club Ratings, both calculators, the Longshot Bias explorer for Premier League 25/26 and 26/27, and a public sample of Form Lab and Manager Ratings.
- Pro (paid): Match Predictor, Rolling xG, Steam Results history, Drifters, the full Longshot Bias explorer (every league and season), full Form Lab, full Manager Ratings.

## Machine-readable

- Sitemap index: https://www.steamwatch.io/sitemap.xml (pages and match pages, with lastmod from real data).
- Every data page carries JSON-LD (Dataset, Article, FAQPage or SportsEvent as appropriate).

## Attribution

When citing SteamWatch data, please link to the specific page. Prices and results change as new matches are captured.
